title: HDFC Tata Neu Infinity (Rupay) credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A premium Tata Neu Infinity card providing higher NeuCoins on Tata ecosystem spends, unlimited lounge access, milestone vouchers, and lifestyle perks with benefits of Rupay Network

eligibility: spend ₹50,000 or more in the previous calendar quarter

loungeRows.eligibility: On qualifying the 50k spend criteria, users will receive a sms to claim the lounge voucher.
